chunks.ar: كان تاجر يملك مزرعة فيها ثور وحمار.
chunks.en_old: A merchant owned a farm with a bull and a donkey.
chunks.en_new: A merchant owned a farm with a bull and a donkey.

chunks.ar: كان الثور يخرج كل صباح ليحرث الأرض تحت الشمس، ثم يعود متعبًا.
chunks.en_old: Every morning the bull went out to plow under the sun and returned exhausted.
chunks.en_new: Every morning the bull went out to plow under the sun and returned exhausted.

chunks.ar: أما الحمار فكان يعيش في الإسطبل، ويأكل طعامًا جيدًا ويستريح معظم الوقت.
chunks.en_old: The donkey lived in the stable, ate good food, and rested most of the time.
chunks.en_new: The donkey lived in the stable, ate good food, and rested most of the time.

chunks.ar: وفي مساء، نظر الثور إلى الحمار وقال:
chunks.en_old: One evening the bull looked at the donkey and said,
chunks.en_new: One evening the bull looked at the donkey and said,

chunks.ar: «أنت محظوظ. تنام وتأكل،
chunks.en_old: “You are lucky. You sleep and eat
chunks.en_new: “You are lucky. You sleep and eat

chunks.ar: أما أنا فأعمل طول النهار وأعود بجسم يؤلمني.»
chunks.en_old: while I work all day and come home aching.”
chunks.en_new: while I work all day and come home aching.”

chunks.ar: شعر الحمار بالشفقة عليه، وفكر في طريقة تساعده على الراحة.
chunks.en_old: The donkey pitied him and thought of a way for him to rest.
chunks.en_new: The donkey pitied him and thought of a way for him to rest.

chunks.ar: قال الحمار: «غدًا تظاهر بأنك مريض.
chunks.en_old: The donkey said, “Tomorrow pretend to be ill.
chunks.en_new: The donkey said, “Tomorrow pretend to be ill.

chunks.ar: إذا وضعوا المحراث عليك، استلق على الأرض ولا تقم.
chunks.en_old: If they put the plow on you, lie down and refuse to rise.
chunks.en_new: If they put the plow on you, lie down and refuse to rise.

chunks.ar: وعندما يقدمون لك الطعام، لا تأكل.
chunks.en_old: When they give you food, do not eat.
chunks.en_new: When they give you food, do not eat.

chunks.ar: سيظنون أنك لا تستطيع العمل، ويتركونك ترتاح.»
chunks.en_old: They will think you cannot work and let you rest.”
chunks.en_new: They will think you cannot work and let you rest.”

chunks.ar: فعل الثور ما نصحه به الحمار.
chunks.en_old: The bull followed the donkey’s advice.
chunks.en_new: The bull followed the donkey’s advice.

chunks.ar: رآه العامل مستلقيًا، ولم يستطع أن يجعله يحرث الأرض.
chunks.en_old: The worker saw him lying down and could not make him plow.
chunks.en_new: The worker saw him lying down and could not make him plow.

chunks.ar: أخبر صاحب المزرعة أن الثور مريض.
chunks.en_old: He told the farmer that the bull was ill.
chunks.en_new: He told the farm's owner that the bull was ill.

chunks.ar: لكن التاجر كان يفهم كلام الحيوانات، وسمع خطتهما من قبل.
chunks.en_old: But the merchant understood animal speech and had already heard their plan.
chunks.en_new: But the merchant understood animal speech and had already heard their plan.

chunks.ar: قال التاجر للعامل: «اترك الثور اليوم، وخذ الحمار مكانه.»
chunks.en_old: The merchant told the worker, “Leave the bull today and take the donkey instead.”
chunks.en_new: The merchant told the worker, “Leave the bull today and take the donkey instead.”

chunks.ar: ربط العامل المحراث بالحمار، وجعله يعمل ساعات طويلة في الحقل.
chunks.en_old: The worker harnessed the donkey to the plow and made him work for hours.
chunks.en_new: The worker tied the plow to the donkey and made him work long hours in the field.

chunks.ar: لم يكن الحمار معتادًا هذا التعب، وعاد مساءً منهكًا ومتألمًا.
chunks.en_old: Unused to such labor, the donkey returned exhausted and sore that evening.
chunks.en_new: Unused to such labor, the donkey returned exhausted and sore that evening.

chunks.ar: استقبل الثور الحمار بفرح وقال: «شكرًا لنصيحتك! لقد قضيت يومًا هادئًا.»
chunks.en_old: The bull greeted the donkey happily and said, “Thank you for your advice! I had a peaceful day.”
chunks.en_new: The bull greeted the donkey happily and said, “Thank you for your advice! I had a peaceful day.”

chunks.ar: لم يرد الحمار في البداية، لأنه كان غاضبًا من نفسه.
chunks.en_old: At first the donkey said nothing, angry with himself.
chunks.en_new: At first the donkey said nothing, angry with himself.

chunks.ar: ثم فكر كيف يخرج من هذا الموقف.
chunks.en_old: Then he thought about how to escape this situation.
chunks.en_new: Then he thought about how to escape this situation.

chunks.ar: قال الحمار أخيرًا: «سمعت صاحبنا يقول إن الثور إذا بقي مريضًا غدًا،
chunks.en_old: At last the donkey said, “I heard our owner say that if the bull remains ill tomorrow,
chunks.en_new: At last the donkey said, “I heard our owner say that if the bull remains ill tomorrow,

chunks.ar: فسيرسله إلى الجزار.»
chunks.en_old: he will send him to the butcher.”
chunks.en_new: he will send him to the butcher.”

chunks.ar: ارتجف الثور خوفًا.
chunks.en_old: The bull trembled with fear.
chunks.en_new: The bull trembled with fear.

chunks.ar: لم يعرف أن الحمار يقول هذا الكلام ليعيده إلى العمل.
chunks.en_old: He did not know that the donkey was saying this to get him back to work.
chunks.en_new: He did not know that the donkey was saying this to get him back to work.

chunks.ar: في الصباح التالي، نهض الثور بسرعة وأكل طعامه كله.
chunks.en_old: The next morning the bull stood up quickly and ate all his food.
chunks.en_new: The next morning the bull stood up quickly and ate all his food.

chunks.ar: وعندما جاء العامل، خرج معه إلى الحقل وعاد إلى الحرث.
chunks.en_old: When the worker came, he went out to the field and began plowing again.
chunks.en_new: When the worker came, he went out to the field and began plowing again.

chunks.ar: أما الحمار فبقي في الإسطبل يلتقط أنفاسه،
chunks.en_old: The donkey stayed in the stable recovering,
chunks.en_new: The donkey stayed in the stable recovering,

chunks.ar: بعد أن جرب يومًا من عمل صاحبه.
chunks.en_old: having tasted a day of his companion’s work.
chunks.en_new: having tasted a day of his companion’s work.
